Name: Cloud's Spikey Hair
Author: Serbagz
Description:
This mod adds Cloud Strife's spikey hairstyle to the Fashion Sense menu. All versions of the hairstyle allow you to recolor the highlight and outline separately. An edited cloak loosely based on his Kingdom Hearts one is also included. This is my first mod for Stardew Valley so please let me know if there is anything I messed up.

[b]Hair[/b]:
-Cloud's Spikey Hair
-Cloud's Spikey Hair - Greyscale
-Cloud's Trimmed Hair

[b]Accessories[/b]:
-Cloud's KH Cloak
-KH Cloak Greyscale

----------------------------------------
Install Instructions:
----------------------------------------
1. Install Fashion Sense (follow its own install instructions)
2. Download this mod either through Vortex or Stardrop using the Mod Manager Download button
3. Done!
